name: MusiCares — U2 2027 Persons of the Year Art Collaboration

company.name: MusiCares
company.description: 2027 MusiCares Persons of the Year event honoring U2 during Grammy Week, with potential for a sponsored/commissioned original artwork, fundraising integration, event visibility and relationship access.

primaryContact.name: MusiCares Person of the Year Team
primaryContact.title: 2027 Person of the Year / Partnerships

nextMove: Await MusiCares response. If no reply, send one concise follow-up after 7-10 business days emphasizing that Keegan is interested in a structured collaboration that creates meaningful fundraising value while also making sense commercially and strategically.
strategicValue: Potential Grammy Week visibility, U2 relationship, music-industry access, major charity credibility and cultural positioning. Valuable only if the structure justifies Keegan's time through a paid/sponsored commission, meaningful commercial participation, extraordinary access/visibility, or another clearly defined strategic return.
notes: Ioana Hall sent the initial outreach from ioana@keeganhall.com on September 13, 2026. Keegan was intentionally not copied on the first email; manager-led outreach is appropriate for this institutional opportunity.
Opportunity trigger: U2 will be honored as the 2027 MusiCares Persons of the Year during Grammy Week in Los Angeles.
Keegan fit: established music subjects including Eddie Vedder and Dave Grohl, elite sports/cultural credibility, and more than $850,000 raised through art-related charitable efforts.

Initial outreach framed the concept around a potential original U2 artwork tied to the 2027 event or fundraising, with possible auction, on-site moment, presentation to the band, or another format useful to MusiCares.

Commercial guardrail: do not default to donating hundreds of hours of original artwork for free. Preferred structure is a paid or sponsor-funded commission with a fundraising component, licensing/reproduction economics, or an unusually valuable strategic return secured in advance.

If MusiCares responds, first clarify budget/sponsorship, U2 participation, rights/approvals, event placement, auction structure, press/content access and any collector-edition or licensing possibilities before committing significant studio time.
A strong structure could be: paid Keegan project fee + original artwork + U2/event integration + auction or charitable revenue component + optional licensed/signed collector edition if rights permit.

Given the February 5, 2027 event, a very large 500-800+ hour original may be unrealistic unless approvals happen quickly. A focused high-detail original or smaller-format premium work may be more practical if the opportunity becomes real.

Follow-up cadence: one follow-up around September 24 if no response. If still no engagement, do not chase repeatedly. Revisit only if a meaningful new trigger appears, such as an announced auction program, sponsor, artist participation, U2 involvement, or direct introduction.

latestCommunication.summary: Ioana contacted the MusiCares Person of the Year team regarding U2's 2027 honor, introduced Keegan's elite-client, music and charity credentials, and proposed exploring whether an original U2 artwork could play a role in the event or fundraising through an auction, on-site moment, presentation or another format built around MusiCares' existing plans.
